text: Medium: login rate limit is keyed by IP only and a successful login of ANY account clears the IP counter; limit is checked before verify, so an insider with an own human account interleaves a login every 8 guesses and guesses others' passwords with no 429. Repro: repro-login-reset.test.ts -> 48 guesses, only 401. Fix: key by IP+handle, clear only the handle key, add a per-handle limit. Assumes attacker owns a human account (CVSS AC:H).
